events.speaker: Marcus
events.text: Look man I'm just thinking about that Mac Studio you had. IT mentioned you didn't return a Mac Studio?

events.speaker: SJ
events.text: Look I don't let the model run commands... there's no way the model could have been backdoored... although that night actually the model was briefly given the ability to run commands... but that wasn't.. I... fuck. But even if the safeguards were removed, the AI must have done it by itself. No one would be stupid enough to intentionally engineer an AI virus...

events.speaker: Marcus
events.text: SJ. I didn't want to get wrapped up in any of this. I didn't know what else to do. They approached me and...

events.speaker: Hallway officers
events.text: In the hallway, one cop says: “I fucking hate techies man, did he say what we need?” The other replies: “...I don't know man let's just grab him.”

events.speaker: Inside the apartment
events.text: Three knocks. No ringing or heartbeat.

events.speaker: Officer
events.text: SJ? It's the police. Could you come to the door for us, please?
